case_number: 2023 INSC 779; Criminal Appeal No. 1456 and 1457 of 2015
summary: Dowry harassment allegations dismissed; insufficient evidence against in-laws in dowry death/cruelty case; stridhan claims addressed; anonymous complaints against judicial officer irrelevant to dowry case; quash petition analysis under Section 482 Cr.P.C.; FIR continuation post-chargesheet permissible for quashing; oral dowry demands uncorroborated; High Court rightly dismissed quash petitions.
legal_provisions_cited: Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; FIR No. 56 of 2013 not quashed; criminal proceedings reinstated; stay on proceedings lifted.
